3752-3769-8193.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3752-3769-8193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Phage.
3752-3769-8193.description:
Donate control of Avacyn to an opponent using Blim.
Kill Phage by any method.
At the beginning of the next end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Phage from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

620-997-2111.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

978-1099-2420.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

553-819-5049.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Leyline of Anticipation.
In response, cast Memory Lapse by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

1978-7685-7714.description:
Cast Arc Reactor by paying its mana cost, reduced by its improvise cost if desired.
When Arc Reactor enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Arc Reactor that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the Arc Reactor token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Arc Reactor token.
Repeat from step 3.
1978-7685-7714.notes: The minimum cost is {2} if you tap five artifacts while casting Arc Reactor. The maximum is {7} if you tap no artifacts.

997-1116-1263-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3175-6798-7424.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1806-1887-2060-5686-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

240-647-2511-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

2292-2730-5237.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

967-3809-3967-6753-7087.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3490-4268-4659-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4268-4659-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2638-4426-6751-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-4426-6751-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2638-4426-6751-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1849-2478.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2510-3532-4842-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-4842-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2350-2421-3705-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4231-4321-4365-5777.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods, two Clues, two Treasures and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
4231-4321-4365-5777.notes: You can replace step 1 with using the Food's own ability to sacrifice it.

224-765-1772-6664.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

774-3257-3470.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3470-5411-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
3470-5411-5720-5721.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Lotus Cobra's trigger.

4067-5042-5611.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
4067-5042-5611.description:
Activate a Sliver by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the Sliver.
Repeat.

764-2021-4802-4969.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause another creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Belt of Giant Strength and Colossus Hammer attached to Master Biomancer.
764-2021-4802-4969.description:
Cause another creature to enter the battlefield under your control with at least 20 +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, putting 20 growth counters on Simic Ascendancy.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's third ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

1284-2178-3523.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1284-2178-3523.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

147-1379-4483.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least once this game.
147-1379-4483.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Echo Storm triggers, creating a copy of itself, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Echo Storm, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
When the Dualcaster Mage token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a copy of Echo Storm, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

3750-3920-5231.notablePrerequisites: Valduk has at least five Auras and/or Equipments attached to it.
3750-3920-5231.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Valduk triggers, creating at least five 3/1 Elemental creature tokens with trample and haste.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod's second ability five times by sacrificing five Elementals, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If Valduk has at least six Auras and/or Equipments attached to it, this combo nets infinite Elemental tokens and colored mana.

1563-1651-1737-4231-4715.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Prized Statue.
When the Prized Statue token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure, a Clue and a Food artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Clue, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate the Prized Statue token and the Treasure token by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

917-1742-5042.notablePrerequisites: You have no cards in hand.
917-1742-5042.description:
Activate Idle Thoughts by paying {2}, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding the two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

813-1269-1777.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Exhume for {1}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Exhume from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1193-2556-4095.notablePrerequisites: There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
1193-2556-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting anything but Mnemonic Wall.
In response, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating copies of Mythos of Illuna that target each permanent besides the original target.
Resolve all copies of Mythos of Illuna besides the original, creating token copies of each permanent besides the original target.
The token copy of Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Radiate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the token lands or other mana-producing permanents created in step 3 by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2, doubling the number of copies created in step 3 each repetition.
